description: crewbus DM delivery: SessionStart registers + backlog, Stop injects waiting DMs at turn end, background waiters (asyncRewake) wake the session when mail lands mid-turn or while idle. Requires `npm i -g @eamonpluto/crewbus` (PATH commands) and CREWBUS_AGENT=<you> per terminal.

hooks.rewakeMessage: crewbus: new DM(s) arrived while you were working — read them above, reply with a DM if needed, or continue current work if unrelated.
